Name: Deck for AXIS Camera Station Pro & 5
Author: Pavel Kotyza
Description: AXIS Camera Station Pro and AXIS Camera Station 5 hotkeys on Stream Deck keys: play / pause, previous / next recording, frame step, bookmark, live / recordings, next camera, PTZ presets, zoom, focus, and any hotkey you map in ACS (go to camera, go to view). Ready-made profiles for Stream Deck, Mini and XL. Independent project, not affiliated with Axis Communications or Elgato. https://www.4xs.dev
Category: Deck for AXIS Camera Station Pro & 5

Actions.Name: ACS Command
Actions.Tooltip: Sends one AXIS Camera Station hotkey to the front window: playback, bookmark, live / recordings, camera and tab navigation, PTZ presets, zoom, focus, hotkeys / logs / configuration. The combo is editable per key.

Actions.Name: ACS Hotkey
Actions.Tooltip: Sends any hotkey you mapped in AXIS Camera Station (F2 → Hotkeys), with your own title — go to camera, go to view, sequences.

Actions.Name: Activate ACS
Actions.Tooltip: Brings the AXIS Camera Station client window to the front so the next hotkey lands in it.
